title: Taiwanese American Association Of Capital District, New York 紐約州首府區台灣同鄉會
content_html:
The Taiwanese American Association of Capital District, New York (TAA-CDNY; 紐約州首府區台灣同鄉會) is a chapter of the Taiwanese Association of America (TAA), the national umbrella organization of Taiwanese American community associations. The chapter serves the Capital District region of New York State, including Albany, Troy, Rensselaer, Schenectady, Colonie, Latham, Malta, Clifton Park, and Saratoga Springs.

The organization was established in 1971, originally under the name Formosan Club of Capital District of New York, and was incorporated as a not-for-profit in 1975. It adopted its current English name through a board vote in 1984 and formally amended that name with the New York State Department of State in 2014. TAA-CDNY is registered with NYS Department of State as a not-for-profit corporation and describes itself as a non-political community organization.

The chapter’s mission is to promote Taiwanese language, arts, culture, and history to its members and the broader local community.
